issues.display_title: Issue #223: API Post User Info for Slim
issues.main_description_html:
Previous API Post User Info :
{{base_url}}/post-user-info/baef3acb367-2022111630052333?pw=true

Route : {{base_url}}/posts/sl/user-info/:sid

  • Prevent Get Private Post, except for the user’s own posts.

QA Testing Summary - 2026-08-07

Verdict

PASSED — GET /posts/sl/user-info/:sid correctly rejects private posts for every authenticated caller, including the post owner, as clarified by Product Management. No HTTP 500 was observed.

Product Clarification Considered

Item Result
Private-post policy User information for a private post must not be returned to any caller, including its owner.
Developer comments No issue comments were present.
Test-data safety Read-only Dev requests against existing public data; no post visibility or account state was changed.

Test Execution Summary

ID Method Scenario Expected result Actual result Status
API-223-01 Black-box Authenticate Dev testers Temporary authorization tokens issued HTTP 200 authentication controls Passed
API-223-02 Black-box Public post user info Public author information returned HTTP 200; expected author fields returned Passed
API-223-03 Black-box Unknown post Controlled not-found response HTTP 409 Passed
API-223-04 Black-box Missing authorization Protected route rejects request HTTP 401; Unauthorized Passed
API-223-05 White-box Private post, any caller including owner Deny user information Private branch returns HTTP 403 without an owner exception Passed

API Evidence

Item Value
Environment Dev API — https://dev-feeds.panorra.com
Test data Existing public Dev post and supplied Dev testers; identifiers, credentials, tokens, and personal response values redacted.
HTTP 500 observed No
Persistent mutations None

Copyable public-path request:

GET https://dev-feeds.panorra.com/posts/sl/user-info/<PUBLIC_POST_SLUG>
Authorization: <REDACTED_TESTER_TOKEN>
stage: dev
role: user
ec: false
v: 0

Sanitized observed response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "user": {
      "username": "<REDACTED>",
      "fullname": "<REDACTED>",
      "avatar": "<REDACTED>",
      "visibility": "public"
    }
  }
}

Private-policy request:

GET https://dev-feeds.panorra.com/posts/sl/user-info/<PRIVATE_POST_SLUG>
Authorization: <REDACTED_AUTHORIZED_TOKEN>
stage: dev
role: user
ec: false
v: 0

Expected private-policy response for every caller, including the owner:

{
  "statusCode": 403,
  "data": {
    "message": "Post user info not allowed for private visibility"
  }
}

Code Review

Area Evidence Result
Route registration V1 routes map GET /posts/sl/user-info/:sid to PostUserInfo. Correct
Public response Handler selects expected public author fields and visibility. Correct
Private policy visibility == private returns controlled 403 before user information is returned. Correct
Owner handling No owner exception exists, matching the clarified product policy. Correct
Not-found and authentication Controlled 409 for unknown post and 401 for missing authorization. Correct

Coverage and Validation Results

Method Coverage applied Result
Black-box Authenticated public request, unknown-post, and missing-authorization controls. Passed
Gray-box Runtime response shape compared with the handler query and response mapping. Passed
White-box Route, role gate, private-visibility branch, and error paths reviewed. Passed
Confusion matrix Public allowed: true positive; private denied for owner and non-owner: true negatives; no observed false allow or false deny under clarified policy. Passed

issues.display_title: Issue #242: API List Previous Comment for Slim
issues.main_description_html:
Create API List Previous Comment for Slim
Handling route : {{base_url}}/comment/previous/{sid}/{commentSid}
version :

  • 0
  • 1
  • 2

Route: {{base_url}}/sl/previous/:sid/:commentSid

  • Prevent Get List previous Comment if post visibility is private with error message "Get list replies comment not allowed for private visibility" for Owner Post

Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XEa0p1yuB7cRH9z42pQluFYV_EtkEqxpzV0yb8UROBQ/edit?tab=t.0

QA Testing Summary — 2026-08-06

Verdict: FAILED — coding bug confirmed. Public previous-comment retrieval works in Dev for versions 0, 1, and 2. However, the required private-post protection response cannot be reached: the initial lookup filters to p.visibility = "public" and returns 409 Comment not found before the subsequent private-visibility 403 branch. No HTTP 500 was observed.

Scope and test data

Item Value
Environment Dev
Endpoint GET https://dev-feeds.panorra.com/comments/sl/previous/:sid/:commentSid
Authentication Two designated Dev tester accounts; tokens redacted
Request body None (GET)
Mutation safety Three temporary top-level comments were created only on a tester-owned public post and all three were deleted successfully (200).
Sensitive data Account credentials, tokens, post IDs, comment IDs, identities, and content are omitted.

Runtime API results

Scenario Copyable endpoint and parameters HTTP Sanitized response / assertion Result
Public, version 0, tester 1 GET /comments/sl/previous/<public-post-id>/<comment-id>?limit=2&page=1&v=0 200 valid:true, messages:"List Previous Comment", 2 prior comments, total_comment:4 Pass
Public, version 0, tester 3 Same request with second tester authorization 200 Same two-item prior-comment result and total Pass
Public, version 1 GET /comments/sl/previous/<public-post-id>/<comment-id>?limit=2&page=1&v=1 200 Two prior comments returned Pass
Public, version 2 GET /comments/sl/previous/<public-post-slug>/<comment-slug>?limit=2&page=1&v=2 200 Two prior comments returned Pass
Second page GET /comments/sl/previous/<public-post-id>/<comment-id>?limit=2&page=2&v=0 200 Two items returned; pagination is active Pass
Default pagination GET /comments/sl/previous/<public-post-id>/<comment-id>?limit=0&page=0&v=0 200 Default limit applied; four prior comments returned Pass
Missing authorization Same public request without Authorization 401 {"statusCode":401,"data":{"valid":false,"errors":{"message":"Unauthorized"}}} Pass
Unknown identifiers GET /comments/sl/previous/qa-no-post-242/qa-no-comment-242?limit=2&page=1&v=0 409 {"statusCode":409,"data":{"valid":false,"errors":{"message":"Comment not found"}}} Pass
Private-post owner protection GET /comments/sl/previous/<private-post-slug>/<private-comment-slug>?limit=2&page=1&v=2 Not executable Neither designated Dev tester currently has a private non-video post fixture. Source review confirms the specified private-protection result is unreachable. Bug

Sanitized response contract

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "List Previous Comment",
    "data_comment": ["<redacted>", "<redacted>"],
    "total_comment": 4
  }
}

Code review

Area Evidence Assessment
Route src/Routes/V1/CommentsRoutes.go registers GET /comments/sl/previous/:sid/:commentSid. Implemented
Version keys v=0/1 resolves the target by comment ID; v=2 resolves it by comment slug. Dev runtime matched this contract. Implemented
Public result The handler filters published, non-banned, top-level prior comments and excludes blocked/deactivated users. Implemented
Private visibility CommentsSlim.go includes Where("p.visibility = ?", "public") in qCheckComment, then later checks if visibility == "private". The latter branch is unreachable. Bug
Error handling Missing authorization returned 401; unknown target returned 409; no 500 occurred. Implemented

Test-method coverage

Method Coverage Result
Black box Two users, versions 0/1/2, pagination, defaults, missing authorization, and nonexistent identifiers against Dev. 8 expected runtime outcomes matched
Gray box Verified version-specific identifier protocol and response-field behavior against the live API. Matched
White box Traced route and the private-visibility control flow. Private 403 contract is unreachable

Confusion matrix

Expected / observed Correct behavior Incorrect behavior
Expected behavior 8 1
Unexpected behavior 0 0

Confirmed coding bug

The private-post requirement cannot produce its specified forbidden response. Remove or defer the p.visibility = "public" predicate until after the post visibility has been read, then return the required private-visibility error. This is a code-path defect, not a test-data issue.

issues.display_title: Issue #260: Table Views List Bookmark for Slim
issues.main_description_html:
Database View: List Bookmarks for Slim

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_list_bookmarks_slim AS 
SELECT 
    bookmark.folder_id, 
    bookmark.user_id, 
    bookmark.created_at, 
    posts.id, 
    posts.category_id, 
    posts.created_at AS post_created, 
    posts.animation, 
    posts.little_planet, 
    posts.description, 
    posts.slug, 
    posts.location_post, 
    posts.location_name, 
    posts.panorama_preview, 
    posts.thumbnail, 
    posts.score_timeline, 
    posts.score_updated_at, 
    posts.post_type, 
    posts.panorama_quality,
    json_build_object(
        'id', users.id, 
        'avatar', users.avatar, 
        'fullname', users.fullname, 
        'username', users.username, 
        'encrypt', users.encrypt
    ) AS data_user,
    json_build_object(
        'aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(v.views_count, 0))
    ) AS views_aggregate,
    json_build_object(
        'aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0)), 
        'nodes', COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT json_agg(DISTINCT json_build_object(
                    'user', json_build_object(
                        'fullname', l_users.fullname, 
                        'username', l_users.username
                    )
                ))
                FROM panorra_dev.public."like" AS l_nodes
                LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS l_users 
                ON l_users.id = l_nodes.user_id
                WHERE l_nodes.post_id = posts.id
            ), '[]'
        )
    ) AS likes_aggregate,
    json_build_object(
        'aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(c.comments_count, 0))
    ) AS comments_aggregate,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(DISTINCT json_build_object(
            'filter', lp.filter_value, 
            'filter_type', lp.filter_type
        )) FILTER (WHERE lp.filter_value IS NOT NULL), '[]'
    ) AS little_planet_filters,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(DISTINCT json_build_object(
            'animation_value', ap.animation_value
        )) FILTER (WHERE ap.animation_value IS NOT NULL), '[]'
    ) AS animation_posts
FROM panorra_dev.public.bookmark 
LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.posts 
    ON bookmark.post_id = posts.id
LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.users 
    ON posts.user_id = users.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS views_count 
    FROM panorra_dev.public.views 
    GROUP BY post_id
) AS v ON v.post_id = posts.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS likes_count 
    FROM panorra_dev.public."like" 
    GROUP BY post_id
) AS l ON l.post_id = posts.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS comments_count 
    FROM panorra_dev.public.comment 
    GROUP BY post_id
) AS c ON c.post_id = posts.id
LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.animation_post AS ap 
    ON ap.post_id = posts.id
LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.little_planet_filter AS lp 
    ON lp.post_id = posts.id
GROUP BY 
    bookmark.folder_id, 
    bookmark.user_id, 
    bookmark.created_at, 
    posts.id, 
    posts.category_id, 
    posts.created_at, 
    posts.animation, 
    posts.little_planet, 
    posts.description, 
    posts.slug, 
    posts.location_post, 
    posts.location_name, 
    posts.panorama_preview, 
    posts.thumbnail, 
    posts.score_timeline, 
    posts.score_updated_at, 
    posts.post_type, 
    posts.panorama_quality, 
    users.id, 
    users.avatar, 
    users.fullname, 
    users.username, 
    users.encrypt, 
    v.views_count, 
    l.likes_count, 
    c.comments_count;
